Getting Started Guide

Create a Product Listing

Click "Add Your First Product" to fill in product details including title, price, description, and images.

Tips & Best Practices

Follow these guidelines to maximize your sales and improve visibility.

📸 Product Images

  • Use clear, high-quality images
  • Show products from multiple angles
  • Use good lighting for better visibility
  • Include product in actual use if possible

✍️ Product Titles

  • Be specific and clear
  • Include key features and brands
  • Use natural language, not all caps
  • Keep it concise (max 100 characters)

📝 Product Descriptions

  • Write detailed and accurate descriptions
  • Highlight key features and benefits
  • Include material, size, and specifications
  • Explain what problem it solves

💵 Pricing Strategy

  • Research competitor pricing
  • Factor in production and shipping costs
  • Offer competitive prices
  • Consider seasonal adjustments

📦 Inventory Management

  • Keep inventory updated
  • Monitor stock levels regularly
  • Plan for restocking
  • Disable listings when out of stock

🎯 Customer Service

  • Respond promptly to inquiries
  • Provide accurate shipping information
  • Package products carefully
  • Follow up with buyers

⚠️ Important Guidelines

Ensure all product information is accurate and truthful. Prohibited items include counterfeit goods, hazardous materials, and items that infringe on intellectual property rights. Violating these guidelines may result in account suspension.
